packageRules.description: The OpenTelemetry operator image and its Helm chart must move together: the chart's RBAC and flags track the operator version, and the image used to be bumped alone (digest of latest, #40), leaving a v0.162 operator running with chart-0.109 permissions. Renovate groups them into one PR; minimumReleaseAge gives the chart time to catch up with a new image release. The image entry in applications/opentelemetry-operator/base/kustomization.yaml carries newTag so it is tracked by version, not by the digest of latest.

The democratic-csi driver is the storage layer for the controlplane and observability clusters and is pinned by digest by hand. As a digest-only kustomize entry Renovate followed the digest of `latest` (#219); keep driver upgrades deliberate and tested.
